outcome: Pelvic Organ Prolapse Distress Inventory (POPDI) score
cohort: Singleton term pregnant women who underwent either operative vaginal delivery (Thierry spatulas or vacuum extractor) or spontaneous vaginal delivery.
finding: Operative vaginal delivery, particularly with spatulas, was associated with a higher prevalence of early pelvic floor dysfunction symptoms, mainly pelvic organ prolapse, at 3 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery, especially with spatulas, was linked to a higher prevalence of early pelvic floor dysfunction symptoms, specifically pelvic organ prolapse, at 3 months postpartum.
